title: Correct tag and vdo.ai.js loading
acceptance: Capture the expected a.vdo.ai/core/<TAGNAME>/vdo.ai.js request; verify the approved tag, script type and HTTP 200. Test missing/wrong tag, 4xx/5xx, cancellation and blocking. Compare payload, script and DOM identities.
decisions: Expected tag mapping is authoritative; deriving it from a hostname alone remains unconfirmed.

title: Load time of vdo.ai.js
acceptance: Measure total request duration in a cold-cache run. Test 499, 500, 501, 1000 and 1001 ms plus timeout. Proposed bands: PASS <=500 ms, WARNING >500 to <=1000 ms, FAIL >1000 ms or timeout.
decisions: Record cache/network conditions. Confirm thresholds before production enforcement.

title: Tag loads only once
acceptance: Count requests and matching implementation elements per tag and page/article epoch. Two different tags are valid; duplicate same-tag injection fails. Capture initiators and DOM mutations. Test duplicate script, duplicate anchor, legitimate distinct tags and a floating unit.
decisions: Floating units need no anchor. Define bootstrap versus injected external script counts and SPA reinsertion policy.

title: Logger requests are firing
acceptance: Capture logger/logger.php requests including xhr and ping, payload, status, initiator and duration. Test present HTTP 200, non-200, no requests and incomplete capture. Attribute absence only after script execution and the observation window.
decisions: Browser collection is sufficient; backend API access is not a prerequisite.

title: Logger event sequence
acceptance: Recognize ad-served Flow A and explainable no-ad Flow B. Test missing critical events and interrupted prerequisites while allowing independent ordering and subsequent ad cycles. Preserve raw names and start-time sequence.
decisions: Confirm exact aliases and critical conditions. Example Flow A places viewability before playback, conflicting with TC-6/TC-10.

title: Individual event checks
acceptance: Cover Loaded, initVdo, conditional Forceplay/Auto_Plays, Pageview, Website Pageview, ATF/BTF, Came In View, eligible Ad Request, Ad Match, Video Loaded/Start, both Pageview Match events, Viewable Impression and conditional Replay. Test each required missing event in its eligible scenario.
decisions: Video Start in no-ad content flow must not require an ad Video Loaded. Criticality is profile-dependent.

title: Pageview counts
acceptance: Test one and multiple active tags: exactly one tag Pageview each and Website Pageview in {0,1} across tags. Detect excess and missing counts; distinguish expected blocks from unexplained formation failures.
decisions: Confirm Website Pageview scope across virtual articles. Do not confuse a count of zero with missing capture.

title: ATF BTF and Came In View
acceptance: Exercise initial ATF, BTF followed by scroll, and early scroll before loading completes. Exactly one ATF/BTF state per eligible tag; Came In View must occur when exposure is observed.
decisions: Use viewport state at the relevant event, not only original document placement.

title: Ad request
acceptance: For an eligible initialized and visible player, test Auto_Plays/Came In View leading to Ad Request or a confirmed equivalent. Inject missing/blocked demand requests and failed prerequisites; cite allowed_url and autoplay evidence.
decisions: Disabled demand or expected policy blocking changes applicability, not publisher correctness.

title: Ad serving chain and viewable impression
acceptance: Identify the first supported gap in Ad Request -> Ad Match -> Video Loaded -> Video Start -> Viewable Impression. Measure >=50% visibility continuously for >=2 seconds for video or >=1 second for banner. Test interrupted exposure and exact boundaries.
decisions: Optional Active View bs/mtos/p are supporting evidence only. No Ad Match alone is INVESTIGATE Demand, not an implementation failure.

title: Blocked events and errors
acceptance: Classify Blocked Player, BlockedInline, BlockedAutoPlay, Blocked IMA, Blocked Agent, Blocked Device, Error including Q2/Bn, and Blocked URL. Verify expected configuration and record browser/device plus preceding evidence.
decisions: Test expected versus unexpected blocks. Five Forceplay attempts require observable attempt evidence; do not infer them from one event.

title: Dependency loading
acceptance: Check required vdo.ai.js, analytics.js, allowed_url, min.js, ima3.js, vdo.player.js, prebid.js and rtb.js against the product profile. Cover HTTP 200, missing, blocked and failed files before attributing missing initVdo to placement.
decisions: Not every product requires every file. Record transport/configuration cause separately from suggested owner.

title: DOM check
acceptance: Verify correct unique anchor and external script, intended non-floating body/content placement, and unexpected removal/recreation. Test missing anchor/Q2, duplicates, wrong ID, wrong placement and valid floating without anchor.
decisions: Collect DOM evidence throughout the run, but present this stage after logger checks as requested.

title: Player formation and CSS layout
acceptance: Test formed versus unformed player, zero dimensions, display/visibility hiding, ancestor overflow clipping, z-index occlusion, transforms, parent layout and fixed/sticky/floating behavior. Distinguish formation failure from publisher CSS obstruction.
decisions: Unobservable cross-frame geometry stays UNKNOWN rather than fabricated viewability.

title: Timing of logger events
acceptance: Record every logger request duration and consecutive-event gaps separately. Test <=500 ms, >500 ms, isolated and repeated spikes, timeout and unavailable timing. Provisional >500 ms warnings must preserve raw measurements.
decisions: Repeated/large-delay FAIL limits and event-gap thresholds are unspecified. Exactly 500 ms is not above the proposed threshold.

title: Device coverage
acceptance: Execute applicable cases on desktop and a named mobile profile, including inline/autoplay/device blocks, playback after tap, placement, dimensions and viewability. Use real iOS/Safari evidence for claims about iOS restrictions.
decisions: Emulation cannot prove real-device behavior. Tablets and CTV remain later phase; missing required real-device evidence is reported unverified.

title: Payload consistency
acceptance: Compare tagName to the script/anchor per tag; domainName to the approved site; page_url to the event-time article; dep within page load. Test wrong/mixed tags, wrong domain, stale article and inconsistent build.
decisions: Multiple different tags are legitimate. Missing fields are TC-20 warnings; do not manufacture mismatches from absent values.

title: Tag to domain match
acceptance: Validate approved product prefix v/c/s/b, configured root-domain mapping and legitimate -v1/-v2 suffixes. Test subdomains, .co.in, valid multiple tags, wrong domain and wrong product.
decisions: Examples alone do not establish a universal derivation algorithm. Unconfirmed mapping is UNKNOWN.

title: Dependency build check
acceptance: Detect dep changes within one physical page load as FAIL. Test consistent build, changed build, empty field and dependencies_dev_3153 on a production profile.
decisions: The meaning of dev is unconfirmed: report an observation until configured policy establishes a development-build WARNING.

title: Event name and field sanity
acceptance: Validate nonempty event, tagName, domainName, page_url and dep; warn on unknown event names or missing/invalid fields. Keep raw event strings and explicit versioned aliases. Test malformed JSON and ignore unrelated payload fields.
decisions: Engineering must supply exact vocabulary; unknown future events must not crash parsing or silently disappear.

title: Current article URL equals logger page_url
acceptance: Snapshot current URL at request start; compare each event with its article epoch. Test matching URL, stale previous article, redirect and query/hash/trailing-slash variants. Delayed responses from the previous article retain their original event-time scope.
decisions: Strict comparison is the draft baseline; permitted URL normalization needs confirmation.

title: loaded and pageview once per article URL
acceptance: Per run/article/tag count loaded=1 and pageview=1. Test duplicate loaded, duplicate pageview with one loaded, pageviews across articles with one loaded, and loaded without pageview. Preserve block/error reasons and multi-tag isolation.
decisions: Apply the document's draft per-article contract; confirm reinitialization versus physical script reload and revisit behavior.

title: Infinite scroll and SPA scenario
acceptance: Keep capture active through at least three distinct articles via scroll or same-document navigation. For every tag/article assert current page_url plus one loaded and pageview; test stale URL, missing reload event and duplicate events.
decisions: Requires a site-specific safe transition action and approved SPA lifecycle contract. Failure to reach three articles means incomplete coverage.
